items.title: Funko and Loungefly kick off a Black Friday sale with up to 70% off through Nov. 29
items.summary: Funko.com and Loungefly.com are running a Black Friday sale with up to 70% off marked items from Nov. 16 through Nov. 29, 2026. Pre-orders and limited edition items are excluded.

items.title: Funko slots new Infinity Saga Pops of Tony Stark, Steve Rogers and Bucky between its Avengers: Doomsday waves
items.summary: New Marvel Infinity Saga Pops numbered #1671-#1674, including Steve Rogers (Chopping Wood) #1671, Tony Stark (Nanotech Suit) #1672 and Bucky #1673, sit right next to the Avengers: Doomsday Pop! waves ahead of the film's December release.

items.title: Funko's KPop Demon Hunters Pop! Mystery 6-pack puts the Saja Boys in blind boxes
items.summary: The $89.99 Pop! Mystery KPop Demon Hunters 6-pack includes blind-boxed Jinu, Abby, Baby, Mystery, Romance and Crying Demon with Pop! cards, a 1-in-72 Mystery Chase and a 1-of-1 Worldwide Chase.

items.title: Funko's next Hazbin Hotel wave brings Adam, Vox, Husk, Niffty and Emily
items.summary: Funko teased a new Hazbin Hotel collection on X. Funko.com lists Pop! Adam (Winner Archangel) with a chance of chase, Vox, Husk and Niffty as coming soon, plus a web-exclusive Emily (Seraphim Angel), each $14.99.

items.title: Plastic Empire opens pre-orders for an exclusive glow-in-the-dark Doc Brown & Einstein Pop!
items.summary: Plastic Empire's Back to the Future Plutonium Glow Doc Brown & Einstein Pop! & Buddy went up for pre-order on Nov. 12 at 10:04 PM ET for $19.99, with fewer than 5,000 available; a $249 Christopher Lloyd-signed, JSA-authenticated Signature Series was offered for 88 hours. Estimated shipping is December to January.

items.title: Dunk and Egg from A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms get Funko Pop! figures
items.summary: Funko's new Pop! figures of Ser Duncan the Tall and Egg from HBO's A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms are up for pre-order at Entertainment Earth for about $15 each.

items.title: Entertainment Earth opens pre-orders for an exclusive flocked Gizmo Pop!
items.summary: Entertainment Earth's exclusive Gremlins Gizmo Pop! has flocked fur, stands about 3.5 inches tall, costs $16.99 and is estimated to arrive in January 2027.

items.title: Funko sends Michael Jordan back up for Space Jam’s game-winning shot
items.summary: Funko’s new Pop! Movies Space Jam Michael Jordan figure puts the star in his Tune Squad uniform, mid-air for the game-winning shot. The 4.6-inch vinyl is $14.99 and is listed on Funko.com as a pre-order shipping November 24, 2026, for the film’s 30th anniversary.

items.title: Funko’s Professor Pyg GameStop exclusive arrives in the classic black apron
items.summary: The Batman Professor Pyg GameStop exclusive dropped at midnight PST on November 11, limited to 9,500 pieces at $19.99, wearing the classic black butcher’s apron and red tie. ComicBook.com independently listed the same November 11 GameStop exclusive, price, and 9,500-piece limit.

items.title: Archer gets its first Funko Pop! wave: Sterling, Malory, Pam and Krieger
items.summary: Funko's debut Archer Pop! wave covers Sterling Archer, Malory Archer, Pam Poovey and Dr. Krieger as Pop! #2640-#2643, with two Chase variants including a black turtleneck Sterling.

items.title: Psyren gets its first Funko Pop! figures, led by the Drifters and Nemesis Q
items.summary: Funko's first Psyren Pop! Animation wave: Yoshina Ageha #2607, Amamiya Sakurako #2608 with a 1-in-6 sword Chase, Asaga Hiryu #2609, Kirisaki Kabuto #2610 and Nemesis Q #2611.
